ns2:course.label: Advanced Health Finance
ns2:course.description: Intended to help students develop an applied understanding of financial management principles and concepts required to implement decisions that lead to effective and efficient financial performance outcomes for healthcare organizations. Course materials are designed to equip students with a competent grasp of advanced fundamentals of financial management skills that include Financial Condition Analysis, Variance Analysis and Cash Budgeting, and Revenue Cycle and Current Accounts Management. Prerequisite: HK 522, related class, or instructor approval. Restricted to Public Health, MPH; Epidemiology, MPH; or Master of Health Administration, MHA programs.
